description: INFLUENCE — what blocks the next agent-readiness band, GATES BEFORE POINTS. Some bands are unreachable on score alone: agent-native requires idempotency AND a stable error envelope regardless of how many points a provider collects. Returns the points gap and the unmet gate requirements separately, each priced, plus a verdict saying whether clearing the gate also closes the gap — the case a points-arithmetic answer gets wrong every time. Priced B2 (cross-catalog synthesis) — $0.05 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

name: readiness_gates
